d: SOOR, a subsidiary of Master Works, helps organizations stay ahead of evolving cyber threats through advanced cybersecurity and secure infrastructure solutions. SOOR delivers resilient, scalable, and regulation-aligned security across governance, cloud, networks, and managed defense.

SOOR is looking for an IT & Strategy Planning Specialist to bridge technology with business goals by developing and tracking IT strategy roadmaps, prioritizing digital investments, and ensuring technology initiatives deliver measurable business value.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
3–5+ years of experience in IT Strategy, Strategic Planning, PMO, Enterprise Architecture, or Technology Consulting.
Strong understanding of IT portfolio management, budgeting, project prioritization, and ROI/business case development.
Proven experience with strategic frameworks, KPI tracking, executive dashboards, and PMO standards.
Solid familiarity with digital transformation methodologies, IT governance, risk management, and cybersecurity regulations.
Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, TOGAF, COBIT, ITIL) are highly desirable.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and executive reporting skills.
Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
r: Develop, maintain, and communicate the IT strategy and multi-year technology roadmap aligned with corporate objectives and security standards.
Lead annual and quarterly IT planning, including budgeting, resource allocation, and investment prioritization.
Assess business needs and emerging technologies, building business cases with clear cost structures, risk assessments, and expected benefits.
Oversee the IT project portfolio, tracking progress, project dependencies, and benefits realization through a PMO framework.
Define and monitor strategic KPIs, performance dashboards, and executive reporting for senior management.
Support enterprise architecture, digital transformation, IT governance, and cybersecurity risk management initiatives.
Manage vendor and stakeholder relationships, serving as a primary link between business units and IT technical teams.
Promote compliance with internal IT policies, security standards, and relevant regulatory frameworks.

d: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Senior Account Executive Manager – Merchant Retail, Riyadh
Big ideas and bigger ambitions? Fascinated by the future and captivated by technology? You belong here.

We’re rounding up the brightest minds to innovate with us across the technology landscape. We need fresh thinking, daring suggestions and raw creativity. We’re in the business of shaping the future – everybody’s future. Our customers and our employees alike. We are Visa.
We don’t deal in money, numbers or figures. We build the ground-breaking technologies and bold solutions that keep our world ticking over, connecting us all, every single day.

It’s our people that keep things running smoothly at Visa. That’s why we invest in each and every one of our staff individually. We want them to grow with us, stick with us and help us reach even dizzier, and more extraordinary new heights.
We’re targeting dynamic thinkers who can get going quickly with our latest exciting job opportunities.

Our mission is to develop Merchant Partnerships across the retail segment in CEMEA. The team engages across multiple functions within the Visa organization to bring the very best of Visa’s expertise and assets to our clients - earning well-qualified wins to drive revenue growth while building trust and growing engagement and satisfaction among teammates, partners, and clients.

This role will act as the regional subject‑matter authority, driving differentiated value for Visa’s top retail merchants by combining data‑driven insights, product expertise, commercialization strategy, and best‑practice replication across markets. The role will partner closely with local market teams, global product, consulting & analytics, and cross‑border solutions to accelerate growth, wallet share, and innovation in the retail ecosystem.
We are looking for a sales and business development expert in a B2B environment with relevant experience in credit cards issuing business.

You will be responsible for managing the assigned client relationships, developing new businesses and program implementations. You will also be responsible for supporting growth of retail merchants in the CEMEA region for Visa. This role requires leadership, vision, and creativity to develop the overall strategy, drive the expansion of Visa products and solutions, and lead the overall commercialization of Visa’s business development objectives. In turn deliver the best of Visa solutions to our clients and help them meeting their business objectives.

This role will be part of the merchant organization in Visa which sits under the broader Merchant, Global Client, Tech partners and Acquiring team. This role will collaborate with teams from functions across Visa such as solutions, consulting & analytics, finance, merchant sales, issuer relationship, customer support, and marketing. Externally, this role will collaborate with key client executives.
q: Proven ability in B2B sales, negotiating business agreements and driving commercial results in retail industry.
Extensive experience in payment products - credit cards, pre-paid, etc. Portfolio P&L expertise, with analytics orientation.
Demonstrated experience in building and leveraging strong relationships at multiple levels including C level executives of the clients.
Ability to work independently and in collaboration within a complex, cross functional and matrix environment.
Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills. Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, AI tools and agents.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
r: Act as the retail SME on industry trends, payment flows and retail economics.
Develop and execute customized account strategy, objectives and plans to increase revenue and market share for select strategic partner accounts in CEMEA
Lead selected strategic regional or global retail merchant engagements directly.
Identify, document, and replicate winning use cases across markets and retail vertical.
Enable markets to move faster by providing templates, frameworks, benchmarks, and case studies.
Build forums and communities of practice across retail specialists.
Lead the account and relationship management and sales plan for these accounts, ensuring that the client’s business objectives are met
Support the development, negotiation and signing of proposals by working with various internal stakeholders and relationships with strategic partner executives
Own and manage portfolio of Merchant Partnerships within the retail vertical. Identify new and ongoing requirements, introduce new products or services, and grow the business.

Conduct financial and business analysis of strategic opportunities for Visa capabilities that increase revenue for both parties through a deep understanding of the partners’ business and evolving industry context, including payment strategy and solutions
Serve as internal and external thought leader responsible for communicating Visa's and merchant partnership vision, strategy and perspective within a rapidly evolving industry

Partner with peers in other functional areas - e.g., marketing, analytics, risk, innovation and across regional teams to execute projects in ways that leverage the breadth and depth of Visa's resources
Continuously review CEMEA landscape, identifying and developing partnerships, venture or acquisition opportunities that will position Visa as the market
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

q: We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to design and build high-performance, scalable, and secure cloud-native applications. The resource will lead development on several key projects, work in a multi-developer Agile (DevSecOps) environment, and upgrade existing .NET and SharePoint applications to the latest cloud technologies.
Backend: .NET Core, ASP.NET, C#, Entity Framework, Microsoft Visual Studio, Unit Testing Frameworks
Frontend: HTML, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript Libraries, jQuery, AJAX, DHTML, React JS / Angular (Minimum 2 Projects or 2 Years Experience)
Database: Proficient MS SQL Server Programming (T-SQL), Design and Optimize SQL Server Stored Procedures
Cloud & Integration: Azure Cloud Technology, Serverless Functions, Logic Apps, Microservices, REST, JSON, SOA
Authentication: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML, Azure AD
Web & Server: Administer IIS 7 and above in Production Environment, Web Browser Compatibility, Mobile Technologies
Architecture: n-tier Architectures (UI, Business Logic Layer, Data Access Layer), Service-Oriented Architectures (SOA)
Legacy: .NET and SharePoint Websites and Applications
Experience: 5 Years in .NET and 2 Years in .NET Core using Azure Cloud Technology plus some legacy development knowledge.
Strong experience in software development using .NET Core, SharePoint, ASP.NET, C#, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Entity Framework.
Ability to work in Agile / DevSecOps / DevOps environment.
Strong troubleshooting, code quality, and documentation skills.
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Information Technology.
r: Design and build high-performance, scalable, and secure cloud-native applications.
Design microservices, APIs, and Web Apps.
Implement Serverless Functions and Logic Apps for event-driven processes and integrations.
Lead development on several key projects.
Work in a multi-developer Agile environment (DevSecOps).
Meet with Solution Architect and Analysts to determine application and website requirements.
Develop identified solutions while respecting functional and organic specifications in compliance with established standards.
Upgrade and revamp existing .NET and SharePoint websites and applications to the latest cloud technology.
Deploy functional websites, programs, and applications using automated process (DevOps and Azure DevOps Cloud Services).
Draft software and application operating procedures.
Work with QA team to ensure quality of product code is up to established standards.
Set up, execute, maintain, and improve quality in procedures and processes for functional application management, including monitoring of correct execution of Master Data Management changes.
Participate in structured walk-throughs and other activities to review systems and provide training and support.
